integrity: The proof uses a complete finite support-factor enumeration with included program and an independent small-instance microscopic replay; no independent external audit is claimed.
limitations: Exact period-18 counts and a universal entry bound, not exact basin counts of the other three periods; recurrence time bound need not be sharp for individual shore sizes. Possible unindexed earlier equivalent.
title: Eighteen-step oscillations in five-color firefly dynamics on tripartite graphs
